title: AuditLogEntry
description: Schema for one JSONL line in .claude/audit/log.jsonl (schema v1.1, introduced Phase E v4.2; unchanged through v4.3)

schema_version.description: Schema version — 1.0 (Phase C), 1.1 (Phase E: telemetry fields promoted)

event.description: Hook event that triggered this entry

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the entry was written

session_id.description: Claude Code session ID from the hook payload

cwd.description: Absolute path of the working directory when the hook fired

transcript_path.description: Path to the session transcript .jsonl file

stop_reason.description: Why the session stopped: end_turn, max_tokens, tool_use, error

tool_input_hash.description: SHA-256 of tool input JSON (PostToolUse only; for tamper detection, not content)

command.description: Platform command invoked in this session (/bug-fix, /test, etc.) — extracted from transcript

gate_a_status.description: Completeness gate result for this session

gate_b_status.description: Regression gate result for this session

platform_version.description: Platform version from .ai/.platform-version.json at session start

contract_hash_status.description: Contract hash check result from hash-check.js

adapter.description: Adapter in use — from .ai/.platform-version.json (Phase E telemetry, v1.1)

user_id.description: OS username ($USER / $USERNAME env var) — factual, not authenticated identity (Phase E telemetry, v1.1)

repo.description: Repository name — basename of cwd (Phase E telemetry, v1.1)

branch.description: Current git branch — read from .git/HEAD (Phase E telemetry, v1.1)

mcp_calls_count.description: Number of MCP tool calls in this session — counted from PostToolUse log entries (Phase E telemetry, v1.1)

_reserved.description: Reserved for future fields. Phase E promoted: adapter, user_id, repo, branch, mcp_calls_count. Still reserved: token_estimate, cost_usd, files_read_count, files_changed_count.
